title: Reproducible product screenshots from pinned demo data
summary: The 2026-08-09 operator decision makes the committed deterministic snapshot the source for documentation and marketing captures. AGT-2530 extends the ADR-0056 pipeline with a sanitized real-workspace export, a complete DEMO-9 decision state, two light/dark landing-page shot pairs, optional rendered annotations, and the --pinned source class across the manifest, backend parser, and UI. Task evidence retains --real, --mocked, and --composite. WEB-17 remains the follow-up for the website manifest-path and asset-sync update. [Closed to History 2026-08-17: all three delivering cards are terminal (AGT-2530, WEB-16, WEB-17, all in lane 7-archive). Verified in code: scripts/seed-demo-workspace.mjs, scripts/presentation-capture/generate.sh and export-pinned-seed.mjs with pinned-seed.json covering DEMO-9, the docs:presentation script in frontend/package.json, the --pinned source class enforced end to end by scripts/visual-docs/validate.mjs against docs/quality/visual-features/manifest.json and parsed in backend/Shared/Models/ScreenshotModels.cs, and the light/dark landing-page pairs with bounded annotations in frontend/e2e/visual-evidence/presentation-capture.spec.ts. Status moves active to documented, so the Dossier leaves the active list and stays readable under History.]
